architecture_continuation_rule: An arm has reasonable signal only if it improves mean inner validation combined NRMSE by >=3% versus R0 in both columns, wins >=3/5 outer-seed means and >=13/25 inner folds in both columns. R3 requires R2 signal; R4 requires R3 signal.
loss_selection_rule: A non-L0 recipe is selected only if it improves mean inner validation combined NRMSE by >=1% in both columns, wins >=3/5 outer-seed means and >=13/25 inner folds in both columns; otherwise retain L0. Ties retain the simpler L0.
prediction_freeze: all final blind validation/test predictions and checkpoints hash-locked before score action reads outer truth

readout_arms.R0: converged P0 architecture, no readout change
readout_arms.R1: P0 + learnable-global-query residual multi-head attention readout
readout_arms.R2: P0 + full audited-condition-query residual multi-head attention readout
readout_arms.R3: R2 + frozen source q50 residual fusion
readout_arms.R4: R3 + frozen source 128D representation residual fusion

source_augmentation.cache: sample_id + source checkpoint SHA256 + feature-table SHA256
source_augmentation.source_prediction: source eval q50 columns [1,4], divided only by source-train scales before fusion
